## Executive Summary

The Nordic construction sector stands at a critical juncture. To meet EU sustainability targets and double circularity levels by 2030, isolated pilot projects are not enough. NECC addresses this gap by creating a platform that connects supply-side innovators, demand-side frontrunners and financial institutions.

NECC builds on a solid consortium of experienced partners across the Nordics. More than 50 companies and organisations are involved from all sides of the table, as well as networks covering all Nordic countries and the Baltics.

The approach is to provide a practical solution for users ready for the market. NECC will deliver a Nordic catalogue of circular solutions, searchable by geography and project needs; AI-supported tools for market insight; advisory services linking suppliers to real projects; overviews of funding, financing and regulation across Nordic markets.

The market potential is substantial. The Nordic construction market represents EUR 300-330 billion annually. Reaching EU circularity targets implies creating a EUR 15 billion Nordic market for circular products within five years. Current circularity levels are only 5-8%, technical potential ranges from 50-95%.

## Impact / Work Packages

### Overall goal/Vision
Within 2030 the Nordic construction and real estate operates in line with national climate and nature goals, while increasing productivity and strengthening the regional resource security in critical construction materials.

### Work Packages

1. **Governance & Management** -- Steering Committee, Advisory Board, Business Model Working Group, project team
2. **Demand-side intelligence** -- Pilot demand-side frontrunners, Go Circular search tool, Circular Frontrunners overview, NECC Advisory Service, Best Nordic Practices in Public Circular Construction
3. **Supply-side upscaling** -- NECC Circular Products and Solutions Catalogue, Market Intelligence Reports, Hot Lead Advisory Service
4. **Business model development** -- Payment for services survey, alternative business model insight, pilot business models tested
5. **Green finance** -- Funding Opportunities overview, Circular Funding Dialogue, Accelerating Circularity conference
6. **Policy harmonisation** -- Nordic Policy & Compliance Map, Circularity Maturity Index, User Guides on Regulations, Nordic Dictionary, Guide to Nordic Business Cultures
7. **Communications** -- LinkedIn (12,100 followers), newsletter (6,800 subscribers), quarterly events, Nordic Circular Summit

## Enabling Cross-Sectoral Innovation

NECC will be embedded in a wider Nordic and international network of circular actors in sectors such as construction, materials, textiles, **food systems** and urban/place development. This positioning enables knowledge transfer across sectors.

## Relevance / Background

- EU legislation expected in 2026 likely to require a circularity level of 23-24% by 2030 (roughly doubling from today)
- Experience from Nordic Circular Construction project shows persistent fragmentation between circular solution providers, property owners, contractors, financiers and policymakers
- NECC aims to accelerate the Nordic transition from linear to circular construction practices

## Risk Assessment

| Risk | Likelihood | Impact | Mitigation |
|---|---|---|---|
| Companies unwilling to participate | Low | High | Recruit from NCC longlist of 150 suppliers; mobilise partner networks |
| Demand side not engaging | Medium | High | Quality assurance; broad supplier set; adjust content based on feedback |
| Not generating circular trade | Medium | Medium | Surveys + business model testing; align with legislation |
| Ambitions outstrip resources | Low | Medium | Activity-based budgeting; quarterly reviews |
| High dev costs | Low | Medium | Pre-project AI/data review; contingency plan |
| Unable to reach target groups | Low | Medium | Proven communication strategy; partner channels |
| Content becomes outdated | Low | Low | AI-tools for monitoring; regular stakeholder updates |
| AI provider instability | Low | Medium | Alternative providers mapped; contingency plan |
